LanguageData.TransparentCoatingFloor.label: transparent coating floor
LanguageData.TransparentCoatingFloor.description: A crystal-coated floor with self-cleaning properties. Its translucent surface is easy to clean and provides excellent hygiene. Ideal for hospitals and laboratories.
LanguageData.TransparentBridge.label: transparent bridge
LanguageData.TransparentBridge.description: A transparent bridge made of crystal material. Can be built over water. Crystal structures are extremely durable, fireproof, and let light pass through to the water below. Supports heavy structures.
